title: In slipstreams of phonemes dreams glean on wakes of namesakes that shake grammar as examiners in laminar flow Yet pressure swirls while sounds unfurl
summary: In slipstreams of phonemes dreams glean on wakes of namesakes that shake grammar as examiners in laminar flow Yet pressure swirls while sounds unfurl in ambient velocities by champions of verbosity #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
In slipstreams
  of phonemes
dreams glean
on wakes
   of namesakes
that shake
   grammar
as
examiners
   in
laminar
   flow

Yet pressure
  swirls
while sounds
  unfurl
in ambient
velocities by
champions
of verbosity

#smallpoems
